name: Kanzaki Asuka
source:
[i]The student council president who enjoys overwhelming support from across the school[/i]

A third-year female student at Tatsuryou Academy.

She serves as the president of the student council and is highly regarded by other students.

Her grades are among the best, not only in her school but in the whole country. Although she plays a serious honor student with a strong sense of justice, she also has a rather playful side.

Although she is at odds with Ryo's older sister, Satsuki, she highly values ​​Ryo's talent and attempts to recruit him as secretary of the student council.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/medorei/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
